LightningComponentBundle.description: A ranked top-N list: groups any object by a field and ranks the groups by a COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN or MAX, server-side.

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Group By Field
property.description: The field to rank by, e.g. Industry or Owner.Name.

property.name: fieldName
property.label: Field API Name
property.description: Leave blank for COUNT to count records. SUM and AVG need a numeric field.

property.name: orderDirection
property.label: Rank
property.description: DESC shows the highest first, ASC the lowest.
